seo.title: Zalando: high-frequency AI markdown pricing - about 6% more profit, validated across 12 markets (2024)
seo.meta_description: Zalando re-optimizes markdowns on millions of items several times a week via forecasting and multi-objective optimization; the system brought about 6% more profit, validated by 23 A/B tests.
seo.resume_citable: Zalando drives the markdowns of several million items through forecasting and multi-objective optimization; validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets, the system delivered about 6% more profit at equivalent sales and revenue.

faq.q: How does Zalando set its markdowns?
faq.a: A demand forecast by gradient-boosted trees feeds a multi-objective optimization that chooses the markdown levels on millions of items, several times a week.

faq.q: What was the impact of the new pricing system?
faq.a: About 6% more profit at equivalent sales and revenue, and a decision time cut from hours to minutes, validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets.

objectif_business: Set the right discount level several times a week on millions of items with a limited shelf life, to maximize profit without sacrificing sales or revenue.
points_cles: High-frequency markdown pricing on millions of items, several times a week.
In-house gradient-boosted trees forecasting and multi-objective optimization (predict-then-optimize).
About 6 percent more profit, decision time cut from hours to minutes.
Evidence level B, validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets, confirmed active status.
description: Zalando, one of Europe's leading fashion e-commerce players, has to re-optimize markdowns on a catalog of several million items, several times a week, with a decision window of a few hours. The system described combines a daily-resolution demand forecast by gradient-boosted trees and a multi-objective optimization framework, following the predict-then-optimize paradigm. It manages the price of around 600,000 items at any given moment across all markets. The new system was validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets during the 2023-2024 sales campaigns, then deployed to production.

resultats.metrique: Profit vs previous approach, at equivalent sales and revenue
Additional weekly profit, large-scale decomposition framework

niveau_preuve.justification: Two technical papers by Zalando's teams describing the system in production, with quantified results validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets. Figures from internal research and not consolidated into financial results, hence a B level.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Re-optimization several times a week, with a window of a few hours to decide markdowns across the whole catalog.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Zalando pricing and data science team.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The daily demand forecast per item and per market, which feeds the markdown optimization. Without a reliable forecast, the trade-off between profit, sales, and revenue degrades.

etapes.detail: Gradient-boosted trees models estimate daily demand per item as a function of price.
An optimization framework chooses the markdown levels that trade off profit, sales, and revenue across millions of items.
The computed markdowns are applied on the site and the app for all relevant markets.
The pricing team validates changes via A/B tests and monitors the profit impact.

prerequis_data: sales and price history per item
cost and margin structure per item
prerequis_orga: compute infrastructure to re-optimize the whole catalog in hours
replication.premiere_etape: Build a demand forecast per item and per price before attaching the markdown optimization to it.

playbook.action: Gather the sales/price history per item and the margin structure.
playbook.livrable: Item x day x price dataset with costs and product life cycle.

playbook.action: Build the demand forecast per item as a function of price.
playbook.livrable: Forecast backtested on history, errors documented by category.

playbook.action: Attach markdown optimization under constraints (profit, sales, revenue) on a sub-catalog.
playbook.livrable: Markdown engine operational on a limited scope.

playbook.action: Validate via A/B tests against the current pricing rules, market by market.
playbook.livrable: Profit readout at equivalent sales and revenue vs previous approach.

playbook.action: Industrialize: short re-optimization window, monitoring, extension to the full catalog.
playbook.livrable: Production system re-optimizing the catalog several times a week.

replication.equipe: 2-4 data scientists (forecasting + optimization) + 1 data engineer + business pricing team

statut_vivant.note: System deployed to production after 23 A/B tests across 12 markets; the publications describe it as deeply integrated into Zalando's production environment.

transposable_ue.note: System already designed and operated in Europe. The pricing covers catalog prices and discounts (markdown), not a price personalized per individual, which limits GDPR exposure. The AI Act requires documenting the use.

stack_technique.detail: Daily-resolution demand forecast per item and per price, the foundation of the predict-then-optimize system.
Chooses the markdown levels that trade off profit, sales, and revenue, with Lagrangian decomposition to hold the scale (around 600,000 items managed at any given moment).
Production chain that re-optimizes the catalog several times a week within a window of a few hours, validated by 23 A/B tests across 12 markets.
